title: War Preparations and Opening Engagement with Wazir Khan

blocks.text: After receiving the Majhail Singhs and ordering priorities against Sirhind, Banda's camp hardens into direct war preparation. The page sets up the first large engagement by placing forces on advantageous ground and describing how the confrontation with Wazir Khan is no longer avoidable.

The most striking military detail is the advance of artillery and camel-loaded guns, which marks the battle as organized imperial warfare rather than a mere skirmish. Wazir Khan's forces launch the opening attack under that firepower, turning strategic movement into open combat.
This page therefore serves as the hinge between planning and impact. The waiting ends, the guns arrive, and the field begins to decide what slogans and vows had only promised.
